label: Build an object
description: Build one JSON object from wired values (a reply body, a request body): each input becomes a key of the same name, in written order, so `job: open.id` beside `status: "running"` is `{"job": "...", "status": "running"}`. Nest by wiring another JsonObject's `object` onto a key. Keys are required, so a closed branch skips the node; a key written `key?:` is left out (not null) when nothing arrives.

outputs.name: object
outputs.description: The object, keyed by input name in written order. A port declaring a record type accepts it when the shape agrees.
